leaves.requirements: Code has been implemented such that a ViT-Base model pre-trained on ImageNet-1K can be loaded into memory using the timm repository

evidence.claim: Public timm/vit_base_patch16_224.augreg_in21k_ft_in1k weights were loaded by timm and evaluated on Tiny-ImageNet corruptions with a GPU matrix.
evidence.scope_limit: Tiny-ImageNet public alternative and toy hierarchy; no ImageNet-1K/OOD or full TTA paper methods

leaves.requirements: Code has been implemented such that a ResNet-50 model pre-trained on ImageNet-1K can be loaded into memory

evidence.claim: Public timm/resnet50.a1_in1k weights were loaded by timm and evaluated on Tiny-ImageNet corruptions with a GPU matrix.
evidence.scope_limit: Tiny-ImageNet public alternative and toy hierarchy; no ImageNet-1K/OOD or full TTA paper methods
